domain: SAP S/4HANA Finance and Logistics Integration
thesis: Start with the logistics event, then trace value, account determination, cost or revenue object, journal evidence, clearing or settlement, and reconciliation.

event_map.baseline: Inventory reduction and typically COGS posting
event_map.caveat: Specialized revenue-recognition or valuated-stock-in-transit scenarios can change timing.

event_map.baseline: Inventory or consumption value against GR/IR for standard valuated procurement
event_map.posting_reading: Dr Inventory or Consumption / Cr GR/IR with valuation and variance rules
event_map.caveat: Price control, account assignment, invoice-before-GR and delivery-cost scenarios differ.

event_map.baseline: Vendor liability plus GR/IR clearing and variances/tax as applicable
event_map.posting_reading: Dr GR/IR and/or expense/variance/tax / Cr Vendor
event_map.caveat: Quantity, price, account-assignment and sequence differences affect details.

event_map.baseline: Accounts receivable plus revenue/tax posting on FI transfer
event_map.posting_reading: Dr AR / Cr Revenue and tax-related accounts
event_map.caveat: Revenue-recognition solutions can add recognition and deferral postings.

event_map.baseline: Actual costs accumulate on the production cost object; output receipt and settlement move value to receivers
event_map.posting_reading: Inventory and production-order/cost-object values are linked
event_map.caveat: Receiver, valuation, variance and settlement logic depend on production costing design.

event_map.baseline: FSD drives MM service procurement/accrual and invoice-verification follow-on
event_map.posting_reading: TM charges → FSD → service PO/SES/accrual → carrier invoice verification
event_map.caveat: Cost allocation to valuation or expense depends on process design.

runtime.question: Which logistics event created the financial state?
Which account-determination logic selects the G/L?
Which object owns the cost or revenue context?
Which journal entry was actually posted?
What should clear or settle the temporary balance?
Do Logistics and Finance describe the same business event?

process_bridges.path: Delivery/PGI → Inventory & COGS → Billing → AR / Revenue / Tax
PO → GR → Inventory/Consumption + GR/IR → Supplier Invoice → Vendor Liability + GR/IR clearing
Component GI / activities → Production Order Actual Cost → Finished Goods GR → Variance / Settlement → Receiver
Freight Charges → FSD → Service PO + SES / Accrual → Carrier Invoice Verification

failure_modes.symptom: PGI posted but COGS/inventory value is unexpected.
GR quantity is correct but value/variance is unexpected.
GR/IR remains open although procurement is believed complete.
Billing value is correct but revenue/receivable posting is wrong or blocked.
Production is technically complete but financial balance/variance/settlement remains.
TM freight charges are approved but MM/FI or carrier invoice state does not match.

reconciliation.question: Why does receipt value not yet match invoice value?
Why does actual production cost remain on the order?
Why do TM charges, accruals and carrier invoice not agree?

what_i_ask_first: Which logistics event created the value?
What should change: stock, expense, COGS, revenue, receivable, liability, accrual, or cost object?
Is the problem amount, G/L, cost object, clearing, settlement, or recognition timing?
lead_lens.main_trade_off: Keep automatic cross-module posting while making financial ownership and reconciliation explainable.
lead_lens.typical_failure: Manual journal repair hides a wrong source logistics event, valuation, or account-assignment input.
